mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE exceeds 8% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses earnings multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO rises for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market tightening, which increases wage pressure and reduces profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when PAYEMS rises for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals weakening residential investment, which reduces construction-related earnings and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST declines for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a sustained 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses earnings multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
